subject.title: fix(control-ui): resolve Personal card avatar 401 via data URI

question: Should maintainers consolidate this bug on https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634 after its SDK-surface blocker is fixed, or ask this contributor to rebase and repair this narrower branch?
rationale: Automation can identify the stale path, compile blocker, and proof gap, but choosing the canonical landing vehicle across overlapping avatar PRs requires maintainer intent while the broader candidate is proof-positive but not yet clean.

options.title: Consolidate on the broader candidate
options.body: Repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634's SDK-surface issue first, then use it as the canonical backend/bootstrap/UI avatar fix and close overlapping branches after it is safe.

options.title: Repair this narrow branch
options.body: Ask this contributor to rebase onto current main, port the UI change to `ui/src/pages/config/quick.ts`, fix the type/lint blockers, add focused coverage, and provide browser/network proof.

options.title: Pause for owner choice
options.body: Keep both branches open until an avatar/UI owner decides the preferred compatibility shape for data URIs versus authenticated blob loading.

recommendation.title: Consolidate on the broader candidate
recommendation.body: Repair https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97634's SDK-surface issue first, then use it as the canonical backend/bootstrap/UI avatar fix and close overlapping branches after it is safe.
